newsitem.title: USA: Universal sees Flavor unit improvements.
newsitem.headline: Universal sees Flavor unit improvements.

text.p: Universal Foods Corp said it expects to see improved revenue and operating profits from its large Flavor Division.
"Our earnings were on target for the quarter, and we are well positioned to remain on track for the remainder of the year," said chief executive Kenneth Manning.
The company reported net income for its first quarter ended December 31 of $13.8 million, up from $13.4 million in the year-ago period. Sales were flat at $193.4 million.
Flavor division revenue was down eight percent on the quarter "primarily as a result of continuing weakness in the North American dairy market," the company said.
"The division is well positioned for the 1997 dairy and beverage season and expects to see year-to-year increases in revenue," Universal said.
Shares in the manufacturer of food ingredients and related systems were off 1/2 to 36-3/4.
